status.evidence: According to Companies House records and the company's official corporate profiles, Radius Limited (Company No. 08260702) remains an active private limited company headquartered in Crewe.

claims.claim: The company reports its Vision-Mercury (GD301) fleet dash cam and safety solution delivers real-time telematics alerts with less than 2 seconds of latency, using H.265 encoding to reduce data transmission costs by 45–50%.

The cloud-based Kinesis Pro fleet platform integrates real-time GPS tracking and live mapping via Google Maps, receiving data over 4G cellular connections with automatic local data buffering and upload resumption when moving through low-signal areas.

The company reports its Stratus OBD tracker hardware utilizes CAN data integration to capture advanced vehicle diagnostics and engine health data directly from the vehicle's onboard diagnostics port, as detailed on the Radius US website.

Radius achieved the ISO 27001 Information Security Management Systems Certification on March 5, 2018, following a two-year preparation project led by its IT Security, Risk and Compliance Officer to establish an internationally recognized baseline for secure product and data platform development.

The company reports in its legal guides that its vehicle tracking systems are designed to adhere to the UK Data Protection Act and UK GDPR frameworks, providing restricted access controls for employee tracking data and aligning with required transparency principles.

A customer case study from Radius highlights the implementation of the integrated Kinesis Pro software platform alongside DCI fuel cards for Activ8 Solar Energies, enabling the customer to synchronize telematics data with commercial fuel usage across their expanding field operations.

Land Recovery deployed the Radius Kinesis Pro system to achieve complete fleet visibility and manage automated weekly FORS accreditation reporting across its scaled fleet of 40 HGVs, 50 excavators, and 90 vans.

In an investor insight by Inflexion, managing director Ben Thompson stated in 2024 that the diversified group behind Radius Limited generates over £4 billion in total revenues across its divisions, which includes Radius Telematics.

In UK Companies House statutory filings for the specific telematics subsidiary, Radius Telematics Limited (Company No. 09970051), net assets increased by 159.1% to £14.88 million for the financial period ending 31 March 2025.
claims.corrected: In UK Companies House statutory filings for the specific telematics subsidiary, Radius Telematics Limited (Company No. 09970051), total assets increased by 159.1% to £14.88 million for the financial period ending 31 March 2025.

claims.claim: Radius announced a strategic partnership with Arnold Clark Vehicle Management (ACVM) in March 2024 to serve as its official telematics provider, delivering vehicle tracking and camera connectivity solutions to ACVM's commercial leasing fleet customers.

Radius entered into a strategic technology partnership with global vehicle tracking and asset management provider Key Telematics in December 2019 to expand its software and deployment capability for large fleets.
The company reports operating a connected global fleet of more than 600,000 vehicles and assets to generate insights for its 2026 fleet mobility report, Signals from the Road.
The company reports managing over 650,000 live telematics and asset subscriptions globally via its core Kinesis platform.

The company reports operating its global headquarters at the 66,000-square-foot "Radius Campus" in Crewe, which accommodates over 500 people, alongside a separate dedicated global telematics headquarters building opened in April 2024 to house over 350 employees.
claims.corrected: The company reports operating its global headquarters at the 66,000-square-foot "Radius Campus" in Crewe, which accommodates over 500 people, alongside a separate dedicated global telematics headquarters building opened in April 2024 to house over 350 employees.
claims.note: The new telematics headquarters building is 44,000 square feet, not 66,000 square feet.

status.evidence: According to Companies House, FLEETSEC LTD. (Company number 15727473) is an active private limited company incorporated on 18 May 2024 and registered in Leeds, United Kingdom.

claims.claim: The company reports its tracking solutions provide live mapping and vehicle telematics capabilities with 2-meter GPS accuracy, alongside premium Google mapping integration, detailed trip reporting, and driver behaviour metrics across its software pricing plans.

The company reports acting as an official UK/US distributor for Quartix telematics systems, offering integrated hardware solutions that range from self-install and onsite-fitted tracking units to Thatcham-approved stolen vehicle recovery products utilizing specialized cellular and VHF communication channels.

The company reports its web-based vehicle tracking software pricing tiers, including a Self Install Device package (£7/month) and an Onsite Installation package (£8/month), both providing core features such as premium Google mapping, detailed trip reporting, geo-fence alerts, 100+ fleet reports, and driver behaviour metrics.

The company reports providing its integrated "Fleetcheck" management dashboard, which offers over 600 built-in reports, direct DVLA links for MOT and Road Fund Licence alerts, fuel card data integration, proactive tyre management, and HGV operator compliance support.
The company reports offering integrated hardware deployment options including a "Self Install Device" plan alongside an "Onsite Installation" model that introduces Driver ID functionality.

The company reports supplying Thatcham-approved and insurance-approved vehicle security systems featuring remote machine immobilisation alongside advanced forward-facing and multi-camera systems with live viewing capabilities.

The company reports offering a dedicated "GDPR & Vehicle Tracking Guide" on its website to help clients understand data protection rules and compliance tips, as seen on the official Fleetsec Homepage.

The company reports that its platform accommodates operations ranging from small car and van configurations up to large heavy goods vehicle (HGV) fleets, supporting fuel card data integration and over 600 inbuilt report options, as detailed on the Fleetsec Website.

The company reports a deployment case study with client HTS, where Fleet Manager Tony Watson stated that the integration of the connected dashcam solution into their fleet of 27 vehicles improved safety and efficiency, as detailed on the Fleetsec Website.
Fleetsec's director Chris Scanlon won an incentive prize for securing the largest single customer in a sales partner program run by vehicle tracking provider Quartix.
Financial registry listings indicate that Fleetsec Ltd operates as a small corporate entity with fewer than 10 employees, a turnover under £1 million, and a balance sheet under £500,000.

Recognition in the Quartix Sales Partner program, where Chris Scanlon of Fleetsec was named the winner of an incentive prize for securing the largest single customer in a quarterly tracking solutions campaign.
The company serves as a UK distributor for Quartix, an established vehicle tracking brand, according to its official Vehicle Tracking product portfolio which features the Quartix partner branding.
The company employs a micro-scale staff of 2 to 10 individuals, operating as a localized fleet consultancy out of its Leeds headquarters, as detailed on its FLEETSEC LinkedIn Profile.
Fleetsec Ltd lists its corporate head office at Matrix House, Goodman Street, Leeds, LS10 1NZ, United Kingdom.
Fleetsec Ltd details its client support availability via direct phone line (+44 113 314 5700) and email during operational hours of Monday through Saturday from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
